MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 15

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 21

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 17

8. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

14. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
